_comment: Stdlib/no-dependency mirror of configs/example_topology.yaml. TWO TEST LAYERS, not duplication: 'pcie_devices' (Layer 1) tests the LINK to each device (enumeration, link-health, AER, BERT, lane margining); 'functional_checks' (Layer 2) tests the DEVICE itself by OS handle (NVMe SMART, GPU ECC/thermal, GMSL, Ethernet, CAN). A GPU appears in BOTH on purpose: Layer 1 verifies its link, Layer 2 verifies its ECC/thermal. See the YAML for the fully annotated version (comments + hex vendor/class/BDF literals).

pcie_devices.name: GPU
pcie_devices._speed_note: Gen5 (32 GT/s NRZ) -- the Zoox compute-platform target

pcie_devices.name: NVMe
pcie_devices._speed_note: Gen4 -- NVMe SSDs stay at Gen4 even on a Gen5 host
